text:
Sam: Morning — quick async standup from me.
- Did: finished kube node tagging for eu-west spillover, landed config for lane-priority.
- Blocker: AMS quota only at 12 GPUs, our prewarm demands need 20, seeing batch rejections ~10%.
- Ask: who can escalate with Cloud/Sales for an emergency bump? Also have PR #412 for autoscaler ready for review.

Priya: I can open the Cloud Support case, ping me the account id + quota screenshot and I’ll request expedite. :+1:

Sam: Account: 12345-org, quota page link: https://console.cloud/quotas/12345 (screenshot in thread). Filing would help — thanks.

Alex: Re: PR #412 — will review shortly, running unit + integration tests now. Expect minor nits. Also scheduling a small canary spike at 11:30 PST to validate routing changes.

Kai: Heads-up — I pushed a change to model-router to add a prefer-region tag fallback. Will hold deploy until autoscaler PR is green. This should let us route to AMS-but-prefer-EU when quota constrained.

Jordan: Noted a KV-cache miss spike during last warmup in eu-west, correlates with node draining. Looking into whether our drain hook preserves warm cache or not. Might be unrelated but putting it here as a potential risk.

Sam: Filing Cloud Support case now, will paste case ID once created. If we don't get quota quick, plan B is toggle spot fallback for the canary.

Priya: Case created: CS-78921, requested +16 A100s in AMS, asked for expedite and cc’d our account rep. I added the prewarm justification.

OpsBot: deploy succeeded: model-router v1.3.5 -> canary nodes (3/3 healthy).

Alex: LGTM on autoscaler after test run, pushing a tiny fix for a race in scale-down. Will merge in ~10m. :shipit:

Sam: Thanks — today's plan: follow up on CS-78921, monitor canary throughput/latency, run a brief blast in eu-west to validate KV-cache behavior post-drain. If quota doesn’t land we flip to spot fallback and notify product.

Kai: I’ll coordinate spot fallback toggles and post ETA here. Expect ~15–30m after autoscaler merge to see steady state.

Jordan: Will continue digging into cache logs and post any SIGTERM/drain traces to #incidents if I find patterns.

Priya: All good from my side after filing. Ping me if CS needs more details. :thumbsup:
